title: Cosmoscope
excerpt: AI-powered knowledge exploration tool that transforms questions into interactive visual knowledge maps

data.text: Cosmoscope is a research assistant that takes any question and builds a visual knowledge graph around it. It searches the web for reliable sources, synthesizes information using AI and presents concepts as an interactive, explorable map. Example: asking "What is quantum entanglement?" creates a visual map showing the main concept connected to related topics like superposition, Bell's theorem and quantum computing.

Features: AI-powered research with Grok 4 Fast, smart source selection (priority to .edu, .gov, authoritative sources), n8n-style interactive knowledge maps with React Flow, source attribution with reliability scores, automatic relationship detection between concepts. Stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Edge Functions), Brave Search API.
